title: Chapter 100
text:
Han Xiao turned around and ran, turning back to shoot at Luo Qing with Hayme bullets, kiting him.

Luo raised her hands and pushed them forward as she ran, releasing a stable force field in front of her to block the bullets. Every time she was hit, a circle of white light would burst out.

The force field was a natural counter to gunners, but the poisonous gas of the Hayme bullets made Luo Qing's HP drop slowly. Moreover, a small part of the impact of the force field was transmitted to Luo Qing. Although it was reduced by more than ninety-five percent, it was still a damage.

Luo Qing's anger rose, and her murderous aura was so dense that it almost liquefied. Speaking of which, if her murderous aura really liquefied, she would probably look like a fountain right now.

After Han Xiao fired the thirteenth bullet, Luo Qing closed in on him, and this kiting took away more than a hundred HP from her.

If the Esper did not specialize in defense, they were basically fragile. Luo Qing's force field was both offensive and defensive, but if she faced Han Xiao head-on, who was protected by the Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor, she would be knocked around in minutes.

Luo Qing noticed this as soon as they started fighting.

Han Xiao suddenly pulled out his retractable katana. With the katana in his right hand and the mechanical arm in his left, he fearlessly clashed with her. Luo Qing immediately condensed her force field and smashed it on Han Xiao's head. However, she found that a thin metal armor appeared on his body and turned into a helmet in the blink of an eye. Han Xiao only tilted his head back slightly and blocked the impact of the force field. With the katana in his right hand and the fist in his left, he tore apart Luo Qing's force field. The two fought fiercely, and the force field was constantly emitting white light waves.

Even Pan Kuang, who was close to Level 40, was defeated in close combat, so it was impossible for Luo Qing to deal much damage to him. However, the force field ability was more troublesome. It could attack from any angle without warning, interrupting Han Xiao's attacks many times.

"Force Field — Throw!"

Han Xiao suddenly felt an invisible force hit his knee.

Luo Qing took the opportunity to open up a distance. Her breasts were undulating, and her lungs were burning. The high-intensity battle had drained her stamina. Espers consumed a lot of stamina, and she had squeezed out stamina many times to replenish her energy. She was exhausted and looked at Han Xiao in shock.

This Sniper was too f * cking good at fighting. He was even more difficult to deal with than a Pugilist!

"Tut, tut, tut." The remaining mercenaries of Rose Militant had finally closed in on him. The first thing they did was to focus their fire on Han Xiao, but he managed to evade their attacks with Slide Step Consecutive Shots. Han Xiao activated Overload, and with a series of continuous attacks from his Berserk Eagle, the mercenaries fell to the ground with blood spurting out of their mouths.

Only Su Li managed to dodge the attack. His movements were vigorous, and he had the free and easy demeanor of a martial artist. He wore a pair of specially made black gloves. On the gloves were patterns that looked like an electronic motherboard. They were currently shining with a dazzling blue light. Han Xiao's sharp senses felt a trace of danger.

"Mechanical Pugilist."

Su Li quickly closed in on him and pressed her hand forward. Her movements were light and weak. Han Xiao's eyes suddenly narrowed as he recognized the origin of the gloves. Su Li's threat level increased tremendously in his heart. He quickly turned around and dodged. He did not dare to face her head-on. He focused his two guns on Su Li, wanting to get rid of her first. However, Luo Qing immediately closed in on him and blocked the bullets with her force field.

The three of them fought endlessly in the desert. Su Li's gloves made Han Xiao's movements somewhat restricted. The two women quickly discovered this point and used it to their advantage, quickly gaining the upper hand. The situation gradually developed in a direction that was disadvantageous to Han Xiao.

"If I don't pay a price, it will be difficult to get rid of these two."

Han Xiao's eyes narrowed, and he suddenly closed in on Su Li. He had always been fearful of Su Li's gloves. This sudden collision stunned Su Li for a moment. Her gloves subconsciously pressed on the magnetically-controlled retractable armor on Han Xiao's chest. The electric current and the high temperature suddenly exploded!

The durability of the retractable armor dropped by almost a hundred points in an instant. This was the first time the magnetically-controlled retractable armor had lost so much durability in one hit!

Han Xiao's chest was burning. The temperature had exceeded the heat resistance of the magnetically-controlled retractable armor and hurt his body. He did not have time to look at the interface. Taking advantage of the short moment when he was close enough, he stabbed Su Li's chest with the Wind Cutter Blade.

Facing Su Li's shocked eyes, the Berserk Eagle fired crazily at her forehead. Mechanics without armor were very fragile. All the bullets in the Berserk Eagle's magazine were shot out.

Bang! Bang! Bang!

I'm going to lift your skull!

Kill one first!

Luo Qing roared and took the opportunity to hit Han Xiao's back.

A sharp pain came from his spine, as if it was about to be broken. Han Xiao endured the pain and slid forward. He turned around and emptied the bullets of the Berserk Eagle. He focused on Luo Qing's legs. Luo Qing's energy was almost depleted after the battle just now. She was like an arrow at the end of its flight. After the sneak attack, she did not have enough energy to keep up with the attack. The bullets broke through her force field and pierced through her knee.

Luo Qing's expression changed drastically. She knew very well how fatal it would be to lose one's mobility when facing a sniper. In a hurry, she wanted to end the battle in one go. She gathered all her force field and wanted to injure Han Xiao's legs.

However, the moment Han Xiao succeeded, he pulled away. The force field exploded where he was originally standing, creating a huge crater!

Luo Qing's heart sank. Her legs were injured, and she was now a target. Han Xiao was sniping from afar, and she could only passively block. Her energy would eventually run out. Despair appeared in her heart.

"It's over!"

Bang! Bang! Bang! From afar, Han Xiao shot steadily with his sniper rifle, wearing down Luo Qing's energy one shot at a time. Under her unwilling and angry eyes, Han Xiao shot her in the head.

You have killed Luo Qing (LV30). You have received 12000 EXP.

You have received [Thermo-Electric Cutting Gloves] x 2.

The theory behind this pair of gloves was based on [Basic Thermodynamics], which he had not learned yet. There was a miniature thermo-electric converter inside, and the energy source was a high-energy battery. It consumed a lot of energy, but it was very powerful. It also dealt bonus damage to metals.

The spoils of war were naturally taken by Han Xiao. Speaking of which, this seemed to be the first time that his equipment had been dropped by a Mechanic class enemy.

Mechanical Pugilists used one or a few types of melee machines as the core of their battle, and they developed special skills around the weapons. Su Li's combat style was relatively low-level Mechanical Pugilists, and she only relied on the power of her equipment.

Some Mechanical Pugilists' equipment had their own skills, and they could only be used when certain conditions were met. Among the four blueprints that Old Man Lu had given him, one of them was a piece of equipment with its own skills.

The mission had been completed, and all that was left was to go back and hand in the reward.

Han Xiao thought about Felonia and decided to go back and take a look. He turned off the EMP Interference Device and checked the precise parts of Thorns that had been burned. He calculated that it would take about fifteen minutes to fix the car, so he immediately got to work.

"There seems to be a group of wanderers near Felonia. I wonder how they are doing now."

Han Xiao thought to himself.

…

Half an hour earlier …

The entrance to Felonia was a fault in the cliff. The pilgrims climbed along the cliff to the bottom. It was pitch black in front of them, and they could only vaguely feel that they were in a space that looked like a corridor. There were narrow walls on both sides, and there was an extended tunnel in front of them.

A young pilgrim turned on his flashlight and saw his surroundings clearly. Everyone's jaws dropped, and their faces were filled with disbelief.
